visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged woman with dark hair tied back, wearing a white top and grey vest, speaks directly to the camera in a modern white kitchen setting. Behind her are white tiled walls and shelves with glass jars. A man in a professional white chef uniform with glasses joins her, gesturing enthusiastically as they stand behind a white marble-patterned countertop. (2) Close-up shots focus on small glass bowls containing white dough starters, different types of flour, and dried fruits. The chef points at the ingredients while the woman observes closely. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the textures of the powdery substances and the translucent quality of the dough samples. (3) The scene transitions to a white stand mixer in operation. Ingredients are added into the silver bowl. The chef stops the machine to pull a piece of dough, stretching it thin between his fingers to show the translucent windowpane effect, demonstrating its development in the brightly lit kitchen environment. (4) Red dried fruits and nuts are added to the mixer. The camera then cuts to a close-up of the chef's hands on the counter as he folds and rolls the dough. He demonstrates a specific technique to form the dough into a large triangular shape, pressing the seams firmly with his fingers. (5) White flour is sifted through a metal sieve over a stencil placed on the dough, creating a decorative heart-shaped pattern. A small scoring tool is used to make cuts. The tray is then slid into a modern built-in oven, followed by a time-lapse of the bread rising and browning. (6) The chef holds up a cooling rack with two large, golden-brown triangular loaves of bread. The woman stands next to him, holding a large promotional poster featuring the chef and various bread types. Yellow captions and graphics appear at the bottom of the screen. (7) The bread is torn apart by hand, revealing a soft, airy crumb with visible fruit pieces. The woman takes a bite, looking up and smiling while talking, her hands raised in a gesture of appreciation for the flavor. The background remains the clean, professional kitchen setup.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy conversational dialogue between a man and a woman begins immediately. The woman has a bright, mid-pitched tone, while the man responds with a warm, professional cadence. An upbeat acoustic guitar and piano BGM plays at a moderate level, setting a positive and energetic atmosphere. (2) As the chef explains the ingredients, his speech rate is moderate and his articulation is very clear. The acoustic BGM continues with a steady tempo of approximately 110 BPM. A soft whoosh SFX marks the transition between different ingredient close-ups, maintaining a high editing pace. (3) The mechanical humming of a stand mixer becomes audible, creating a low-frequency texture beneath the voices. The speakers maintain their conversational volume over the machine noise. A sharp "ding" SFX is heard as a variety-show style text box appears on the screen. (4) Short, percussive thudding sounds and the rustle of plastic occur as the chef handles and shapes the dough on the counter. His voice drops slightly in pitch as he focuses on the technical explanation, demonstrating high confidence and authority in his vocal delivery. (5) A melodic swell in the BGM occurs during a visual montage of the baking process. The sound of a metal sieve tapping and the light scraping of a blade are heard clearly. The audio environment remains clean, suggesting a controlled studio or high-quality field recording. (6) The vocal arousal increases as the finished bread is presented. The man's voice is triumphant, while the woman's tone is filled with excitement. A crisp, crackling sound of the bread crust being torn apart is prominently featured, providing a tactile acoustic experience. (7) During the tasting, the woman makes high-pitched vocalizations of delight. Her speech is faster and more animated. The BGM reaches a final cadence and fades out smoothly alongside the closing promotional remarks, concluding with high signal-to-noise clarity.
